translations.web: All of them come for violence. Their hordes face the desert. He gathers prisoners like sand.
translations.bsb: All of them come bent on violence; their hordes advance like the east wind; they gather prisoners like sand.
translations.kjv: They shall come all for violence: their faces shall sup up as the east wind, and they shall gather the captivity as the sand.
translations.asv: They come all of them for violence; the set of their faces is forwards; and they gather captives as the sand.
